units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:6">Sabb. III, 6</cite> <he>מְטַלְטְלִין וכ׳</he> you may handle (on the Sabbath) a new lamp; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to make unsteady, to exile; (with דעת) to confound.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:2">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>טַלְטֵל עצמך וכ׳</he> banish thyself (travel) from place to place.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:1">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> (expl. <he>הניעמו</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 59:12">Ps. LIX, 12</cite>) <he>טַלְטְלֵימוֹ</he> make them exiles.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:31">Y. Peah I, 15ᵈ</cite> top (expl. <he>נעו</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 5:6">Prov. V, 6</cite>) <he>טי׳ הקב״ה מתן וכ׳</he> the Lord made unsteady (irregular) the reward of the observants, that they might observe the commands in faith.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (ed. Amst. p. 238ᵃ) <he>שהן מְטַלְטְלִין דעתו וכ׳</he> they (carnal pleasures) confound man’s judgment (cmp. <cite ref="I00859"><he>טָרַף</he></cite>).—Part. pass. <he>מְטוּלְטָל</he>, f. <cite ref="M00983"><he>מְטוּלְטֶלֶת</he></cite>. Tanḥ. ed. Bub., Sh’mini 7 <he>והדעת מט׳</he> and the mind becomes confused.—

senses.gloss: to be moved, handled; to be made restless. Sabb. l. c. כל הנרות מִטַּלְטְלִין all lamps may be handled. Ib. 35ᵃ מעיין הַמִיטַּלְטֵל a travelling spring (changing its place).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:2">Gen. R. s. 39</cite>. Sifra Sh’mini ch. VII, Par. 6 <he>מִטַּלְטְלִין במלואם</he> are carried with their contents; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:1">Kel. XV, 1</cite> <he>עשויין לִיטַּלְטֵל וכ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 964">Yalk. Prov. 964</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 30:7">Midr. Prov. to XXX, 27</cite> Alexander the Macedonian <he>שנ׳ בכל וכ׳</he> who in his unrest drove all over the world like a locust &c.; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="M01006"><he>מִטַּלְטְלִין</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (with דעת) to be confounded. Tanḥ. Sh’mini 5 נִתְטַלְטְלָה דעתו וכ׳ his mind is confused, and he knows not what he is talking &c. Ib. כדי שלא תִטַּלְטֵל דעתו in order that he may not get mixed up; a. e.
